title: domain.round
description: Round a decimal at a precision: round (half away from zero), ceil, floor. `precision` is the number of decimal places kept; a negative precision rounds to tens (-1), hundreds (-2), ...; absent or null means 0. `round` goes to the nearest multiple with ties away from zero, also for negatives (-0.125 at 2 -> -0.13, -2.5 at 0 -> -3); `ceil` goes towards plus infinity (-1.239 at 2 -> -1.23); `floor` towards minus infinity (-1.231 at 2 -> -1.24). The result's trailing zeros are not significant.

value.description: The decimal to round (canonical decimal string).

precision.description: Decimal places kept; negative = tens, hundreds, ...; null or absent = 0.

value.description: The rounded value (canonical decimal; compared numerically).
